services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Watch your student tap into their passions, develop new skills, and have tons of fun at our youth theater Summer Camps in acting, musical theater, writing, design, and more! Your student will shine like they’re born to be at camps featuring music from Wicked, KPop Demon Hunters, The Greatest Showman, Taylor Swift, and Lin-Manuel Miranda. There’s even a two-week production camp of Shrek The Musical KIDS! Sign up today for Village Theatre’s KIDSTAGE Summer Camps, and watch your student discover their inner glow: Summer Camps run June 22-August 14, 2026. Enrollment age is based on the grade level your student will enter in Fall

services.desc: The Everett Performing Arts Center is owned and supported by the City of Everett as a service to the entire Everett community. services.name: School Programs
services.desc: We provide theatre arts integration workshops to match your class curriculum during school, or introductory acting/musical theatre classes after school. All lessons fulfill learning standards. Lessons can be built to fit your school’s interests, schedule needs, and budget. Bring Village Theatre KIDSTAGE classes to your after-school program. Providing a variety of curriculum for elementary and middle-school aged students, KIDSTAGE programs expand valuable life skills such as collaboration and critical thinking, while developing confident actor/creators in an atmosphere that encourages fun, commitment, and taking creative risks in a safe environment.
